dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないよ。今は……」
dialogues.en: "That's the way things are, now..."
dialogues.text: "That's the way things are, now..."

dialogues.jp: この声は……。
dialogues.en: That voice...
dialogues.text: That voice...

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「未来を操作するなんて、やりたかないけどね」
dialogues.en: "I cannot do anything to change the future."
dialogues.text: "I cannot do anything to change the future."

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと見える、神社の風景。聞き覚えのあ
る声。
dialogues.en:
A hazy glance around me revealed that I was in the shrine.
And that familiar voice...
dialogues.text:
A hazy glance around me revealed that I was in the shrine.
And that familiar voice...

dialogues.jp: その声の主を俺は見上げている。
dialogues.en: I looked up at the voice's owner.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the voice's owner.

dialogues.jp: 紛れもなく、俺のばあちゃんだ。
dialogues.en: No doubt, that was my grandma.
dialogues.text: No doubt, that was my grandma.

dialogues.jp:
頭に手を載せられて、ぐしゃぐしゃとかき回さ
れている。
dialogues.en: She was rubbing my head and hair vigourously with her hand.
dialogues.text: She was rubbing my head and hair vigourously with her hand.

dialogues.jp:
そして、隣には……あの夢で見た、幼い環が同
じように見上げていた。
dialogues.en:
And beside me... was the young Tamaki I had seen, in dreams
previous, looking up at her as well.
dialogues.text:
And beside me... was the young Tamaki I had seen, in dreams
previous, looking up at her as well.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「この子の力が暴走するよりマシさ。どんな未
　来でも無くさせたくはないもの」
dialogues.en:
"This child's power must be controlled. Futures, as we know
it, may cease to be."
dialogues.text:
"This child's power must be controlled. Futures, as we know
it, may cease to be."

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんは、今度は環の頭を優しく撫でてい
た。俺の時と対応がえらく違う。
dialogues.en:
This time, grandma patted Tamaki on the head, far more
gently than she had done with me.
dialogues.text:
This time, grandma patted Tamaki on the head, far more
gently than she had done with me.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺達を心配そうに見守る女の人──赤
と白の巫女服を着た人が立っていた。
dialogues.en:
There was another woman as well, watching worriedly over
us--a woman in a Miko uniform.
dialogues.text:
There was another woman as well, watching worriedly over
us--a woman in a Miko uniform.

dialogues.jp: おそらく、環の死んだお母さんなのだろうな。
dialogues.en: Seems like it's Tamaki's deceased mother.
dialogues.text: Seems like it's Tamaki's deceased mother.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「この子は、本当に巫女になる資質を持った子
　のようだからね。それをむざむざ潰すことは
　ないさね」
dialogues.en:
"This child holds the qualities and nature of a Miko. It
would be impossible to keep them latent forever."
dialogues.text:
"This child holds the qualities and nature of a Miko. It
would be impossible to keep them latent forever."

dialogues.jp: 巫女がこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: The Miko nodded.
dialogues.text: The Miko nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、未来は変えられる──確か、昔からの
　あんたの持論だったね？」
dialogues.en:
"But, well, you used to say, that it was your opinion that
the future can be changed, hm?"
dialogues.text:
"But, well, you used to say, that it was your opinion that
the future can be changed, hm?"

dialogues.jp: また、こくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Another nod, from the Miko.
dialogues.text: Another nod, from the Miko.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「なるようになる。後はこの子次第さ」
dialogues.en: "I see, I see. Then, it's just about this one."
dialogues.text: "I see, I see. Then, it's just about this one."

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんが、そう言ってまた俺の頭をくしゃ
くしゃとかき混ぜる。
dialogues.en:
Grandma, in so saying, once again switched her hair-messing
attention to me.
dialogues.text:
Grandma, in so saying, once again switched her hair-messing
attention to me.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「って言っても、あんたには、二人の未来が見
　えてるんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Can you see the future of these two?"
dialogues.text: "Can you see the future of these two?"

dialogues.jp:
巫女は、口の端を少しだけあげ、優しそうに笑っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Each end of the Miko's lips rised slightly, in a gentle
smile.
dialogues.text:
Each end of the Miko's lips rised slightly, in a gentle
smile.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「ちなみに、こっちは念のためって感じだね。
　その子に会うことがなけりゃ、わざわざ思い
　出したりすることはないだろうけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Heh, just wanted to make sure, which you seem to be."
dialogues.text: "Heh, just wanted to make sure, which you seem to be."

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんが、ケラケラと笑う。
dialogues.en: Grandma startec cackling away.
dialogues.text: Grandma startec cackling away.

dialogues.jp: それも、うるさいくらいに。
dialogues.en: So noisy...
dialogues.text: So noisy...

dialogues.jp: 笑うばあちゃん。
dialogues.en: Grandma's laughing...
dialogues.text: Grandma's laughing...

dialogues.jp: 笑うばあちゃんは、うるさい。
dialogues.en: Her laughing was so noisy...
dialogues.text: Her laughing was so noisy...

dialogues.jp: ──うるさいってんだよ。
dialogues.en: ---Way too noisy.
dialogues.text: ---Way too noisy.

dialogues.en: "Daaaah! Geez!"
dialogues.text: "Daaaah! Geez!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は勢いよく上半身を起こす。
dialogues.en:
I woke with a start, my body instantly moving into a sitting
position.
dialogues.text:
I woke with a start, my body instantly moving into a sitting
position.

dialogues.jp: ん？　あれ？
dialogues.en: Hm? Ehh?
dialogues.text: Hm? Ehh?

dialogues.jp: ああ、夢か。
dialogues.en: Ahh, a dream...
dialogues.text: Ahh, a dream...

dialogues.jp: って、電話の音じゃないか！
dialogues.en: ...No wonder, that's the phone!
dialogues.text: ...No wonder, that's the phone!

dialogues.jp: 俺は慌ててベッドから飛び起きる。
dialogues.en: I flew out of bed like a bolt of lightning.
dialogues.text: I flew out of bed like a bolt of lightning.

dialogues.jp: ダッシュで階段を降りた。
dialogues.en: A quick dash down the stairs,
dialogues.text: A quick dash down the stairs,

dialogues.jp: 走って玄関に駆け降り、受話器を手にする。
dialogues.en:
A run to the entranceway, and finally the phone receiver was
in my hands.
dialogues.text:
A run to the entranceway, and finally the phone receiver was
in my hands.

dialogues.jp: 「もしもし」
dialogues.en: "Hello?"
dialogues.text: "Hello?"

dialogues.jp: 息切れのするかすれた声で、電話に出る。
dialogues.en: I answered the phone, out of breath.
dialogues.text: I answered the phone, out of breath.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『あ、朝倉様ですか？　わたくしです。環です』
dialogues.en: "Ah, is that Asakura-sama? It's me, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Ah, is that Asakura-sama? It's me, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: ん？　環か。
dialogues.en: Mm? Tamaki?
dialogues.text: Mm? Tamaki?

dialogues.jp:
電話なんて、何の用事だろう。っていうか、環
から電話してくるなんて。
dialogues.en:
What does she want that she would need to use the phone for?
I've never talked to her over the phone before.
dialogues.text:
What does she want that she would need to use the phone for?
I've never talked to her over the phone before.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　何かあったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, what's up?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, what's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『はい。実はご相談がありまして……』
dialogues.en: "Well, I wanted to discuss a certain matter with you..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I wanted to discuss a certain matter with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Mm? What about?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What about?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『あの、もしよろしければ、神社まで来て頂け
　ませんか？』
dialogues.en: "Erm, perhaps you could come to the shrine instead?"
dialogues.text: "Erm, perhaps you could come to the shrine instead?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　電話じゃだめなのか」
dialogues.en: "Hm? It can't be told over the phone?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? It can't be told over the phone?"

dialogues.jp:
受話器の向こうから、環の戸惑いが伝わる。し
まった、そんなつもりじゃなかったのに。
dialogues.en: Damn, I've made her flustered... that wasn't my intention.
dialogues.text: Damn, I've made her flustered... that wasn't my intention.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめん。わかった、行くよ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I'd head over now."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I'd head over now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『すみません』
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「すぐ仕度するから、待ってて」
dialogues.en:
"I need a bit of time to make myself presentable, so wait a
little?'
dialogues.text:
"I need a bit of time to make myself presentable, so wait a
little?'

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『はい。お待ちしてます』
dialogues.en: "Yes, I will."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I will."

dialogues.jp: 環が受話器を置くのを確認し、俺も電話を切る。
dialogues.en:
I waited for her to hang up, before putting the receiver
back myself.
dialogues.text:
I waited for her to hang up, before putting the receiver
back myself.

dialogues.jp: 「話って、何だ？」
dialogues.en: "What does she want to say, I wonder?"
dialogues.text: "What does she want to say, I wonder?"

dialogues.jp: 何か、あったのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Did something happen?
dialogues.text: Did something happen?

dialogues.jp:
とにかく、行ってみるしかないな。環に会えば、
それもすぐにわかるだろう。
dialogues.en: Well, the sooner I get there, the sooner I'd find out.
dialogues.text: Well, the sooner I get there, the sooner I'd find out.

dialogues.jp: 俺は洋服を着替え、神社へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
I changed quickly into a casual shirt and jeans, and headed
for the shrine.
dialogues.text:
I changed quickly into a casual shirt and jeans, and headed
for the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お呼びたてして、すみません」
dialogues.en: "My apologies for calling you out so suddenly."
dialogues.text: "My apologies for calling you out so suddenly."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当に、お休みだというのに……」
dialogues.en: "You sounded quite sleepy over the telephone..."
dialogues.text: "You sounded quite sleepy over the telephone..."

dialogues.jp: 環は申し訳なさそうな顔をして、俺に謝る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki honestly apologized to me, with a face full of guilt.
dialogues.text: Tamaki honestly apologized to me, with a face full of guilt.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、いいよ。どうせ暇だったし」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, it's free time after all."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, it's free time after all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。うっかり昼過ぎまで寝てたから、起こ
　してもらって丁度よかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Sleeping beyond noon is a waste of free time anyway,
so your call was just perfect."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Sleeping beyond noon is a waste of free time anyway,
so your call was just perfect."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あのまま寝ていたら、夕方になっても起きな
　かったかもしれないからな」
dialogues.en:
"If I'd kept on sleeping, I might not have waken up till
evening."
dialogues.text:
"If I'd kept on sleeping, I might not have waken up till
evening."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、朝倉様ったら」
dialogues.en: "Haha, that sounds like Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Haha, that sounds like Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: ようやく環の顔に微笑みがさした。
dialogues.en: Her face finally broke out into a smile.
dialogues.text: Her face finally broke out into a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「で、相談っていうのは？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what did you want to talk about?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what did you want to talk about?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの、実は学校で巫女部を作りたいなと思っ
　ているんです」
dialogues.en:
"Um, well, I was thinking about starting a Miko Club as one
of the school's clubs."
dialogues.text:
"Um, well, I was thinking about starting a Miko Club as one
of the school's clubs."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「巫女部？」
dialogues.en: "Miko Club?"
dialogues.text: "Miko Club?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の頭の中で、巫女装束を着た女の子達が、払
い棒を振りながら駆け寄ってくる。
dialogues.en:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits, dueling with
wooden swords.
dialogues.text:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits, dueling with
wooden swords.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、朝倉様なら、部活動のことについて何
　かご存知かと思って」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I thought Asakura-sama might know more about the
activites that clubs do."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I thought Asakura-sama might know more about the
activites that clubs do."

dialogues.jp:
俺の頭の中で、巫女装束を着た女の子達が、ざ
ぶざぶと滝に打たれて祝詞を唱えている。
dialogues.en:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits at the bottom
of a waterfall, changing ritual prayers.
dialogues.text:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits at the bottom
of a waterfall, changing ritual prayers.

dialogues.jp:
俺の頭の中で、巫女装束を着た女の子達が、皆
で弓を射っている。
dialogues.en:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits, all cocking
bows, about to fire.
dialogues.text:
In my head, I imagined girls in Miko outfits, all cocking
bows, about to fire.

dialogues.jp:
｛あで／艶｝やかに｛くれない／紅｝の｛すそ／裾｝を｛ひるがえ／翻｝し、学校のグラウンドを駆
ける巫女、巫女、巫女……。
dialogues.en:
The scarlet and white of Miko overrunning the school, Miko
everywhere...
dialogues.text:
The scarlet and white of Miko overrunning the school, Miko
everywhere...

dialogues.jp: シュールだ……。でも、いいかもしんない。
dialogues.en: How surreal... although I don't think it'd be too bad.
dialogues.text: How surreal... although I don't think it'd be too bad.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、妄想から現実へと呼び戻される。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's voice pervaded the depths of my imagination.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's voice pervaded the depths of my imagination.

dialogues.jp:
同時に頭の中で巫女装束の女の子達は、遠くへ
と走り去って行った……。
dialogues.en:
At the same time, the visions of Miko in my head started
flying away...
dialogues.text:
At the same time, the visions of Miko in my head started
flying away...

dialogues.jp: ちょっと惜しい気がしないでもない。
dialogues.en: I felt almost disappointed.
dialogues.text: I felt almost disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫ですか？　ぼおっとしてらっしゃいま
　すが……」
dialogues.en: "Are you alright? You seemed distracted..."
dialogues.text: "Are you alright? You seemed distracted..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、悪い悪い。ちょっと考え事をな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, my bad. I was just thinking."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, my bad. I was just thinking."

dialogues.jp: やっとの思いで思考を立て直す。
dialogues.en: I quickly reorganized my thoughts.
dialogues.text: I quickly reorganized my thoughts.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、何で急に巫女部なんか……」
dialogues.en: "Why did you think of this so quickly?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you think of this so quickly?"

dialogues.jp: 興味のあるところだ。
dialogues.en: When did she become interested in this?
dialogues.text: When did she become interested in this?

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、巫女になることを部にするというと
ころが変わっている。
dialogues.en:
In the first place, a club about Miko would be weird to
begin with.
dialogues.text:
In the first place, a club about Miko would be weird to
begin with.

dialogues.jp: 今、その神秘のベールが明らかになる。
dialogues.en: This mystery needs to be unveiled, before going any further.
dialogues.text: This mystery needs to be unveiled, before going any further.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。以前の朝倉様のように、巫女に興味を
　持って神社を訪れる人が増えたものですから」
dialogues.en:
"Well, even before you, there were several people who
visited the shrine, with a vested interest in Miko, so...
dialogues.text:
"Well, even before you, there were several people who
visited the shrine, with a vested interest in Miko, so...

dialogues.jp: ふーん。なるほどね。
dialogues.en: Ahh, I see.
dialogues.text: Ahh, I see.

dialogues.jp: ま、そんな大げさなものでもないか……。
dialogues.en: Just a simple thing, after all.
dialogues.text: Just a simple thing, after all.

dialogues.jp:
それより、学校で部を設立するには、どうすれ
ばいいんだ？
dialogues.en:
I wonder who I can talk to about forming a school club,
though...
dialogues.text:
I wonder who I can talk to about forming a school club,
though...

dialogues.jp: ここは我が妹に尋ねるか……。
dialogues.en: I suppose my sister would be best...
dialogues.text: I suppose my sister would be best...

dialogues.jp:
やはり、学園の細かいことは、風紀委員の音夢
に聞くべきである。
dialogues.en:
She knows about every speck of information regarding the
school.
dialogues.text:
She knows about every speck of information regarding the
school.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺、音夢に相談してみるよ」
dialogues.en: "Alright, I'd talk with Nemu about it."
dialogues.text: "Alright, I'd talk with Nemu about it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう。少し待っててくれ」
dialogues.en: "Sure. I'd be right back."
dialogues.text: "Sure. I'd be right back."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「用事はそれだけ？」
dialogues.en: "Was that all you wanted?"
dialogues.text: "Was that all you wanted?"

dialogues.jp: 環は伏目がちに答える。
dialogues.en: Tamaki shied her eyes away from me, as she spoke.
dialogues.text: Tamaki shied her eyes away from me, as she spoke.

dialogues.jp: なんだ。
dialogues.en: Huh.
dialogues.text: Huh.

dialogues.jp: これだったら、電話でも済むじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
If that was all, she could've just asked me for my help over
the phone.
dialogues.text:
If that was all, she could've just asked me for my help over
the phone.

dialogues.jp: 何でわざわざ神社に呼び出したんだろう。
dialogues.en: Why did she so suddenly call me to the shrine, then?
dialogues.text: Why did she so suddenly call me to the shrine, then?

dialogues.jp: ま、でも環に会えたから、よしとするか。
dialogues.en: Well, it's okay. I got to see Tamaki again, after all.
dialogues.text: Well, it's okay. I got to see Tamaki again, after all.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺帰るな」
dialogues.en: "In that case, I'm heading back."
dialogues.text: "In that case, I'm heading back."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
と答えつつ、環は何か言いたそうだ。
dialogues.en: She answered, but I heard faint words after...
dialogues.text: She answered, but I heard faint words after...

dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ……ありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um... again, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um... again, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そっか、じゃあ」
dialogues.en: "It's no problem. Later."
dialogues.text: "It's no problem. Later."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環と別れ、神社を後にした。
dialogues.en: I turned around, and headed out of the shrine.
dialogues.text: I turned around, and headed out of the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと歩いて、ふと立ち止まる。何か、後ろ
が気になった。
dialogues.en:
After taking a few steps, I couldn't shake a feeling from
behind my back.
dialogues.text:
After taking a few steps, I couldn't shake a feeling from
behind my back.

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、環は境内の真ん中でまだ立ってい
た。
dialogues.en: I turned around, to see Tamaki still standing there.
dialogues.text: I turned around, to see Tamaki still standing there.

dialogues.jp:
俺の方をじっと見ている。どこか寂しげな、切
なげな感じがした。
dialogues.en:
She was staring at my shrinking figure. She seemed painfully
lonely...
dialogues.text:
She was staring at my shrinking figure. She seemed painfully
lonely...

dialogues.en: "...Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: 環は黙ったまま、小さく手を振った。
dialogues.en: Tamaki remained silent, giving me a wave.
dialogues.text: Tamaki remained silent, giving me a wave.

dialogues.jp: 俺も小さく手を振り返す。
dialogues.en: I gave her a farewell wave too.
dialogues.text: I gave her a farewell wave too.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それだけ。もしかしたら、単に見送って
いただけなのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
But somehow, it didn't feel like a simple matter of seeing
each other off...
dialogues.text:
But somehow, it didn't feel like a simple matter of seeing
each other off...

dialogues.jp:
なのに……妙に心にひっかかった。深く考えす
ぎなのかもしれないが……。
dialogues.en:
My heart felt... caught up into it. Maybe I'm thinking about
it too deeply...
dialogues.text:
My heart felt... caught up into it. Maybe I'm thinking about
it too deeply...

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、いいか」
dialogues.en: "...Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "...Well, whatever."

dialogues.jp: 環の視線を感じつつ、俺は神社を後にした。
dialogues.en: I left the shrine, still feeling her eyes on my back.
dialogues.text: I left the shrine, still feeling her eyes on my back.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.jp:
居間に入ると音夢がソファーでテレビを見てい
る。
dialogues.en:
Entering the living room, I found Nemu in her usual position
on the sofa, watching TV.
dialogues.text:
Entering the living room, I found Nemu in her usual position
on the sofa, watching TV.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あら、兄さんお帰り」
dialogues.en: "Ah, welcome back, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Ah, welcome back, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おう。お前、朝はどこへ行ってたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, there you are. Where did you go in the morning?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, there you are. Where did you go in the morning?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　風紀委員の仕事だけど……。兄さんこ
　そ、今までどこに行ってたの？」
dialogues.en:
"Mm? Just discplinary committee work... and I could ask the
same of you, nii-san."
dialogues.text:
"Mm? Just discplinary committee work... and I could ask the
same of you, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おう、ちょっとな……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I was just..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I was just..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は適当に｛あいづち／相槌｝を打つ。
dialogues.en: I paused for dramatic effect.
dialogues.text: I paused for dramatic effect.

dialogues.jp:
ここで、変なこと言って、音夢にあらぬ疑いを
かけられるのも面倒だからな。
dialogues.en:
If I don't phrase this correctly, she'd get suspicious,
which'd cause all sorts of trouble...
dialogues.text:
If I don't phrase this correctly, she'd get suspicious,
which'd cause all sorts of trouble...

dialogues.jp: 巫女部について聞いてやらないと……。
dialogues.en: The idea of a Miko club may not sit too well with her...
dialogues.text: The idea of a Miko club may not sit too well with her...

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Well, um, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Well, um, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ、部活を作ろうと思ったら、何人ぐら
　い必要なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "How many people would one need, in order to start a club?"
dialogues.text: "How many people would one need, in order to start a club?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何の話？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Why're you asking about that?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Why're you asking about that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何か特別な申請がいるのか」
dialogues.en: "I have a... special request, of sorts."
dialogues.text: "I have a... special request, of sorts."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、部活動なんて始めるの？」
dialogues.en: "...You want to start a club?"
dialogues.text: "...You want to start a club?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が意外そうな顔をして聞いてくる。
dialogues.en: She was expectedly surprised.
dialogues.text: She was expectedly surprised.

dialogues.jp: 無理もない。
dialogues.en: I better not push it.
dialogues.text: I better not push it.

dialogues.jp:
今まで部活は『かったるい』の一言で、帰宅部
にしか属さなかったわけだからな……。
dialogues.en:
Having been a member of the "Going Home After School Club"
most of my life, any lie would be easily caught out...
dialogues.text:
Having been a member of the "Going Home After School Club"
most of my life, any lie would be easily caught out...

dialogues.jp:
下手に勘ぐられるより、率直に話した方がいい
か。
dialogues.en: I'd better be truthful about it.
dialogues.text: I'd better be truthful about it.

dialogues.jp: 「巫女部を作りたいと思ってな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, a Miko club."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, a Miko club."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「巫女部？」
dialogues.en: "Miko Club?"
dialogues.text: "Miko Club?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が変なものを見るような目つきになる。
dialogues.en: Her eyes started to gaze at something far away.
dialogues.text: Her eyes started to gaze at something far away.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと兄さん、変な趣味が……？」
dialogues.en: "Hold on, are you thinking about..."
dialogues.text: "Hold on, are you thinking about..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「違う」
dialogues.en: "No!"
dialogues.text: "No!"

dialogues.jp: いかん、あらぬ誤解を招いたか。
dialogues.en: Here comes the misunderstandings...
dialogues.text: Here comes the misunderstandings...

dialogues.jp: 「実は、環が巫女部を設立したいらしくて」
dialogues.en:
"It's not actually me, it's Tamaki who wants to create a
Miko club."
dialogues.text:
"It's not actually me, it's Tamaki who wants to create a
Miko club."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんが巫女になるんじゃなくて？」
dialogues.en: "It's not that you want to be a Miko?"
dialogues.text: "It's not that you want to be a Miko?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「誰がなるか！」
dialogues.en: "The hell!?"
dialogues.text: "The hell!?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「よかった。思わず兄さんの巫女姿を想像し
　ちゃったよ」
dialogues.en:
"Whew... I was imagining you in a Miko costume... it wasn't
pretty."
dialogues.text:
"Whew... I was imagining you in a Miko costume... it wasn't
pretty."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「するな」

俺の頭の中で、巫女装束の女の子たちが瞬時に
巫女装束の俺に変わってしまった。
dialogues.en:
The previous Miko who took residence in my head, morphed to
become clones of myself.
dialogues.text:
The previous Miko who took residence in my head, morphed to
become clones of myself.

dialogues.jp: ウゲゲ……我ながら、おぞましい。
dialogues.en: Gaaaaahh.... that's disgusting.
dialogues.text: Gaaaaahh.... that's disgusting.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、どうして巫女部なんか？」
dialogues.en: "But, why a Miko club?"
dialogues.text: "But, why a Miko club?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さあ。俺も詳しいことは……」
dialogues.en: "I'm not sure. I don't know all the details either."
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure. I don't know all the details either."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は不思議そうな顔をしている。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked at me inquisitively.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked at me inquisitively.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、やきもちは妬かれてないらしい。
dialogues.en:
Well, at the very least, she doesn't seem to have gotten
jealous.
dialogues.text:
Well, at the very least, she doesn't seem to have gotten
jealous.

dialogues.jp:
音夢にとっても、巫女部という響きにきっと珍
しさを覚えるのだろう。
dialogues.en:
The sheer oddness of a Miko club's probably the main reason
keeping her senses from realizing my fears...
dialogues.text:
The sheer oddness of a Miko club's probably the main reason
keeping her senses from realizing my fears...

dialogues.jp:
俺みたいに、巫女装束の女の子が襲ってくるか
どうかは定かではないが。
dialogues.en: Good thing only I can see the Miko in my imagination.
dialogues.text: Good thing only I can see the Miko in my imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうねえ。同好会としてなら、一人からでも
　発足できるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if she has great interest in it, she can start it by
herself."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if she has great interest in it, she can start it by
herself."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「同好会？」
dialogues.en: "Just by herself?"
dialogues.text: "Just by herself?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。部として昇格するには、それなりの人
　数が必要だし、風紀委員の審査も必要だけど」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Although if she wants the club to expand, she needs
to attract more people and pass the committee's
inspections."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Although if she wants the club to expand, she needs
to attract more people and pass the committee's
inspections."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「同好会なら、あまり厳しい制約はないの」
dialogues.en:
"But as long as she really wants to, there's nothing
stopping her from trying."
dialogues.text:
"But as long as she really wants to, there's nothing
stopping her from trying."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm."

dialogues.jp:
その辺りの、専門的なことはよくわからんが
……。
dialogues.en:
Although that still leaves me clear on the adminstrative and
technical aspects...
dialogues.text:
Although that still leaves me clear on the adminstrative and
technical aspects...

dialogues.jp: ともかく、環に知らせてやろう。
dialogues.en: In any case, I have to inform Tamaki.
dialogues.text: In any case, I have to inform Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢、サンキュ」
dialogues.en: "Thanks a bunch, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Thanks a bunch, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢に礼を言うと、早速受話器を手に環に
電話をかける。
dialogues.en: I hurried to the phone, and dialed Tamaki's number.
dialogues.text: I hurried to the phone, and dialed Tamaki's number.

dialogues.jp:
３回コールした後、聞き覚えのある声が耳に入っ
てくる。
dialogues.en:
On the third ring, a familiar sweet-sounding voice emnated
from the earpiece.
dialogues.text:
On the third ring, a familiar sweet-sounding voice emnated
from the earpiece.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『はい、胡ノ宮です』
dialogues.en: "This is the Konomiya residence."
dialogues.text: "This is the Konomiya residence."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、環？　俺」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tamaki? It's me."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tamaki? It's me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『あら、こんばんわ。先ほどはありがとうござ
　いました』
dialogues.en: "My, good evening. Thank you for your time earlier."
dialogues.text: "My, good evening. Thank you for your time earlier."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう。それより、さっきの巫女部の話だけど」
dialogues.en:
"That's actually what I wanted to tell you about. The Miko
club you were talking about, earlier."
dialogues.text:
"That's actually what I wanted to tell you about. The Miko
club you were talking about, earlier."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『何か判りましたか？』
dialogues.en: "What have you found out?"
dialogues.text: "What have you found out?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「音夢に聞くところによると、同好会として発
　足するなら可能らしい」
dialogues.en:
"According to Nemu, as long as you're dedicated to it, you
can start a club by yourself."
dialogues.text:
"According to Nemu, as long as you're dedicated to it, you
can start a club by yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『え！　本当ですか？』
dialogues.en: "!! Really?"
dialogues.text: "!! Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「風紀委員に申請用紙を出せば、それでいいみ
　たいだ」
dialogues.en:
"Just fill up the application form and send it to the
discplinary committee."
dialogues.text:
"Just fill up the application form and send it to the
discplinary committee."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『そうですか。朝倉様、わざわざ知らせてくれ
　て、ありがとうございます』
dialogues.en: "I see! Asakura-sama, thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "I see! Asakura-sama, thank you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ま、こんなことならお安い御用さ」
dialogues.en: "As long as I could help."
dialogues.text: "As long as I could help."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『……朝倉様』
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何？　まだ何かあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's up? Is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's up? Is something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『……今日は、神社まで来てくれてありがとう
　ございました』
dialogues.en: "...Thank you for coming to the shrine today."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you for coming to the shrine today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『ちょっとお話したい、と思っていたので……、
　わたくしのわがままで、ごめんなさい』
dialogues.en:
"I wanted to talk to you, even for just a little while... I
apologize for my selfishness."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted to talk to you, even for just a little while... I
apologize for my selfishness."

dialogues.jp: そうか……それで。
dialogues.en: Ah.. that must be why.
dialogues.text: Ah.. that must be why.

dialogues.jp:
あの時、気づくべきだった。環が何故、あそこ
で見送っていたかを。
dialogues.en:
When I noticed, at that time, she seemed to be staring
longingly at my back...
dialogues.text:
When I noticed, at that time, she seemed to be staring
longingly at my back...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『御迷惑おかけしました』
dialogues.en: "I know I'm always being a bother..."
dialogues.text: "I know I'm always being a bother..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいんだ。お安い御用だよ」
dialogues.en: "Not at all... I wanted to help."
dialogues.text: "Not at all... I wanted to help."

dialogues.jp: 何だか照れる。
dialogues.en: I started to get embarassed.
dialogues.text: I started to get embarassed.

dialogues.jp: 俺に会いたかった、って意味だよな。
dialogues.en: She wanted to see me... what could she mean by that...?
dialogues.text: She wanted to see me... what could she mean by that...?

dialogues.jp:
まあ、俺も暇つぶしになったし、環に会いたかっ
たって気持ちがなかった訳ではない。
dialogues.en:
Well, I had free time, that's why we ended up seeing each
other anyway...
dialogues.text:
Well, I had free time, that's why we ended up seeing each
other anyway...

dialogues.jp: …………会いたかった？
dialogues.en: ...Seeing each other?
dialogues.text: ...Seeing each other?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『では、おやすみなさい。また学園で』
dialogues.en:
"Again, thank you, and good night. I shall see you at
school."
dialogues.text:
"Again, thank you, and good night. I shall see you at
school."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう。またな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, later."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, later."

dialogues.jp: 少し間があり、環が受話器を置く音が聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
After a short while, I heard the click of the line being
cut.
dialogues.text:
After a short while, I heard the click of the line being
cut.

dialogues.jp: 俺も、ゆっくりと受話器を置いた。
dialogues.en: I slowly put the receiver back down, as well.
dialogues.text: I slowly put the receiver back down, as well.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、受話器を見つめてしまう。耳の奥に
環の声が残っていた。
dialogues.en:
I spent a few minutes just staring silently at the phone.
Tamaki's voice still reverberated in my ear.
dialogues.text:
I spent a few minutes just staring silently at the phone.
Tamaki's voice still reverberated in my ear.

dialogues.jp: 何だろ、この気分？
dialogues.en: What is this feeling I hold?
dialogues.text: What is this feeling I hold?

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいか……」
dialogues.en: "Whatever..."
dialogues.text: "Whatever..."

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、役にたてたみたいだし。巫女部と
いうのも、それはそれで面白い。
dialogues.en:
It seems I've just helped create a club. I'm sure the Miko
club will be really interesting from here on.
dialogues.text:
It seems I've just helped create a club. I'm sure the Miko
club will be really interesting from here on.

dialogues.jp:
好奇心と、ちょっぴりの期待。やはり、ユニ
フォームは赤と白の……。
dialogues.en:
It left me with a taste of curiosity, and just a bit of wild
expectation. The uniform will surely be red and white...
dialogues.text:
It left me with a taste of curiosity, and just a bit of wild
expectation. The uniform will surely be red and white...

dialogues.jp: 今度、覗いてみるか。
dialogues.en: I'd have to take a peep every now and then.
dialogues.text: I'd have to take a peep every now and then.

dialogues.jp: ◆環の相談◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki's Consultance?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki's Consultance?◆

dialogues.jp:
休みの日、けたたましい電話の音で俺は目覚め
る。
dialogues.en:
On the vacation day, the shrill ring of the telephone served
as my signal to get up.
dialogues.text:
On the vacation day, the shrill ring of the telephone served
as my signal to get up.

dialogues.jp:
受話器を取ると、環からの電話で、相談がある
から神社へ来て欲しいとのことだった。
dialogues.en:
It was Tamaki, who wished to consult me about a matter, and
requested I went to the shrine.
dialogues.text:
It was Tamaki, who wished to consult me about a matter, and
requested I went to the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
環の相談は、巫女部を設立したいと言うもので、
音夢に聞くと、同好会としてなら発足可能だと
言われる。
dialogues.en:
She wanted to know whether she could start a Miko Club, and
talking with Nemu showed the answer to be a yes.
dialogues.text:
She wanted to know whether she could start a Miko Club, and
talking with Nemu showed the answer to be a yes.

dialogues.jp: 早速、環に話すと、とても感謝されてしまった。
dialogues.en: I quickly informed the grateful Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I quickly informed the grateful Tamaki.
